title: pane run --worktree survives one failed git fetch
notes: Retro 2026-11-26: in the hermes session, pane run --worktree failed 9 times with 'session run failed: Command failed: git fetch origin master ... Permission denied (publickey)', a transient SSH failure, and the agent wrote retry loops by hand. The fetch is in src/main/actions/worktree/make.ts (~line 127). Retry the fetch once; if it still fails, cut the worktree from the local remote-tracking ref and print a warning that it may be stale, rather than refusing.

comments.body: Follow-up, not in #378: a card ship's own fetch (ship-flow.ts:52) still refuses on the same transient SSH failure.
Pull request #378 opened: pane run --worktree survives one failed git fetch https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/378

Review loop: 2 rounds, floor-addressed, CI passed on c5ce1df4, no conflict with main. Converged, ready to merge. Round 1 (4793cae4) added a 1s pause before the second fetch, skips the retry for a branch the remote lacks, puts the reason on one line and pins a 60s limit per fetch. Round 2: 983bbcf9 added workers-decision-10 (a refused key is tried again). c9be99f7 was rejected by the final check and reverted (c5ce1df4) because it let an OpenSSH '** WARNING' banner become the reported reason. Still open, low: the warning can quote git's generic 'Could not read from remote repository' instead of ssh's own line. Design unchanged from the card: one retry, then cut from the remote-tracking ref with a stale warning.
Pull request #378 merged: pane run --worktree survives one failed git fetch https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/378
